results.name: Mountain Climber Jumps
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Jump one foot forward toward your hands, with the other leg extended behind.
Switch legs in mid-air so the opposite foot lands forward.
Keep switching quickly while holding your hips level.
tips: Keep your shoulders over your hands.
Don't let your hips bounce up.
results.description: Mountain Climber Jumps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Quadriceps, Chest.

results.name: Overhead Med Ball Throw
instructions: Stand facing a wall or open space, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Bend slightly at the knees and hips and take the ball back behind your head.
Throw the ball forward explosively with your arms and core.
Catch the rebound or retrieve the ball and repeat.
tips: Brace your core so your lower back doesn't overextend.
Release the ball at head height.
results.description: Overhead Med Ball Throw is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a medicine ball, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Lats, Chest.

results.name: Pike Alternating Opposite Hip Taps
instructions: Start in a pike position, hips high, with your hands and feet on the floor.
Shift your weight onto one hand.
Reach the other hand back to tap the opposite hip or ankle.
Return the hand to the floor and alternate sides.
tips: Keep your hips high and still.
Move slowly to stay balanced.
results.description: Pike Alternating Opposite Hip Taps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Triceps.

results.name: Pike Individual Alternating Arm Reaches
instructions: Start in a pike position, hips high, with your hands and feet on the floor.
Shift your weight onto one hand.
Reach the other arm forward in line with your head.
Return it to the floor and alternate arms.
tips: Keep your hips high and level.
Press the floor away with the supporting hand.
results.description: Pike Individual Alternating Arm Reaches is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Pike Jacks Feet Kicking in and Out
instructions: Start in a pike position, hips high, with your hands and feet on the floor.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep repeating while your hands stay planted.
tips: Keep your hips high and your arms straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
results.description: Pike Jacks Feet Kicking in and Out is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the cardiovascular system (cardio). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the cardio category. Secondary muscles: Core, Hamstrings, Abductors.

results.name: Pike Shoulder Taps
instructions: Start in a pike position, hips high, with your hands and feet on the floor.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Place the hand back down and tap with the other hand.
Keep alternating with your hips still.
tips: Widen your feet for more stability.
Move slowly and with control.
results.description: Pike Shoulder Taps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Plank Individual Arm Reach
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and feet hip-width apart.
Brace your core and lift one arm straight forward.
Hold briefly without letting your hips rotate.
Place the hand back down and switch arms.
tips: Widen your feet if you lose balance.
Keep your hips level.
results.description: Plank Individual Arm Reach is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Obliques.

results.name: Plank IYTW
instructions: Start in a high plank with your feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Lift one arm straight overhead in line with your body (I), then return it.
Lift it diagonally (Y), then out to the side (T), returning to the floor each time.
Bend the elbow and pull it back (W), then repeat the sequence with the other arm.
tips: Keep your hips steady throughout.
Squeeze your shoulder blade with each position.
results.description: Plank IYTW is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders.

results.name: Plank Lunges
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Bring your right knee forward and place your right foot outside your right hand, keeping your left leg extended straight back.
Return your right foot to the plank position.
Repeat the movement with your left knee, bringing your left foot forward to place it outside your left hand. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move your leg slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you bring your foot forward and inhaling as you return to the plank position.
Ensure your body stays in a straight line, avoiding sagging hips or raised buttocks.
results.description: Plank Lunges is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Plank Pushup
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other, until you are in a high plank.
Lower back to one forearm, then the other.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.
tips: Keep your hips from rocking.
Widen your feet for more stability.
results.description: Plank Pushup is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest.
